required_amount = #{requiredAmount}, planned_hours = #{plannedHours},
reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, review_note = #{reviewNote} WHERE enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} AND status = 'SUBMITTED'
